initial_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.
final_rules: FAIL any visible scratch, stain, or surface damage; PASS otherwise.

rounds.rules: Inspect the bottle top view for true physical damage compared to reference shape. PASS when form matches and differences are consistent with normal variation in lighting, glare, reflection on the curved rim, exposure, or minor loose dust and fibers. A thin faint white curved hairline, glare streak, or fiber-like mark on the outer rim without depth, grooving, pitting, chipping, discoloration, or embedded stain is acceptable variation and must PASS even if not visible in reference; do not FAIL on reflection or removable lint alone. FAIL only for clear persistent defects indicating damage: distinct scratches with depth or material removal, embedded stains or discoloration, chips, cracks, dents, or deformation of the bottle or rim.
rounds.rationale: Narrowed the fail-on-any-mark rule to require depth or persistence for FAIL and explicitly classified thin rim reflections and loose fibers as acceptable variation to stop false FAILs while still catching real scratches and stains.
